ns2:section.sectionText: Geometric Approximation Algorithms. This course will cover some basic algorithms in geometric approximation algorithms, from grids, quadtrees, well-separated pairs decomposition, coresets, LSH, proximity search, and similar topics. Prerequisite: CS 473 or equivalent. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for MCS: Computer Sci OFF - UIUC or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
